Control Title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Description: Maintain an accurate, detailed inventory of all enterprise assets with the potential to store or process data, including end-user devices, network devices, IoT devices, and servers. Review and update the inventory at least biannually or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard Title: Address Unauthorized Assets
Description: Ensure that a process exists to address unauthorized assets on a weekly basis. The enterprise may choose to remove the asset from the network, deny the asset from connecting remotely, or quarantine the asset.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard Title: Utilize an Active Discovery Tool
Description: Utilize an active discovery tool to identify assets connected to the enterprise's network. Configure the tool to run daily, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard Title: Use Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) Logging to Update Enterprise Asset Inventory
Description: Use DHCP logging on all DHCP servers or IP address management tools to update the enterprise asset inventory. Review and use logs to update the inventory weekly, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Enterprise Assets
Safeguard Title: Use a Passive Asset Discovery Tool
Description: Use a passive discovery tool to identify assets connected to the enterprise's network and update the enterprise asset inventory weekly, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory
Description: Establish and maintain a detailed inventory of all licensed software installed on enterprise assets. Review and update the inventory at least biannually or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Ensure Authorized Software is Currently Supported
Description: Ensure that only currently supported software is designated as authorized in the software inventory. Remediate out-of-support software with an exception documenting business need.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Address Unauthorized Software
Description: Ensure that unauthorized software is either removed from use on enterprise assets or receives a documented exception. Review monthly, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Utilize Automated Software Inventory Tools
Description: Utilize software inventory tools, when possible, throughout the enterprise to automate the discovery and documentation of installed software.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Allowlist Authorized Software
Description: Use technical controls to ensure that only authorized software can execute or be accessed. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Allowlist Authorized Libraries
Description: Use technical controls to ensure that only authorized software libraries, such as specific .dll, .ocx, .so, etc. files, are allowed to load into a system process. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

Control Title: Inventory and Control of Software Assets
Safeguard Title: Allowlist Authorized Scripts
Description: Use technical controls to ensure that only authorized scripts, such as specific .ps1, .py, etc. files, are allowed to execute. Reassess bi-annually, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Data Management Process
Description: Establish and maintain a data management process that addresses data sensitivity, data owner, handling of data, data retention limits, and disposal requirements based on sensitivity and retention standards. Review and update annually.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Data Inventory
Description: Establish and maintain a data inventory based on the enterprise's data management process, inventorying sensitive data at a minimum.

Safeguard Title: Configure Data Access Control Lists
Description: Configure data access control lists based on a user's need to know. Apply data access control lists, also known as access permissions, to local and remote file systems, databases, and applications.

Safeguard Title: Enforce Data Retention
Description: Retain data according to the enterprise's documented data management process. Data retention must include both minimum and maximum timelines.

Safeguard Title: Securely Dispose of Data
Description: Securely dispose of data as outlined in the enterprise's documented data management process, using disposal methods appropriate to the sensitivity of the data.

Safeguard Title: Encrypt Data on End-User Devices
Description: Encrypt data on end-user devices containing sensitive data, using full-disk or equivalent encryption.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Data Classification Scheme
Description: Establish and maintain an overall data classification scheme for the enterprise, used to determine the priority and sensitivity of data. Review and update the scheme annually.

Safeguard Title: Document Data Flows
Description: Document data flows, including a description of the data, the source(s), and destination(s), across systems and third parties. Review and update annually.

Safeguard Title: Encrypt Data on Removable Media
Description: Encrypt data on removable media containing sensitive data.

Safeguard Title: Encrypt Sensitive Data in Transit
Description: Encrypt sensitive data in transit, using techniques such as Transport Layer Security (TLS) and Open Secure Shell (OpenSSH).

Safeguard Title: Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest
Description: Encrypt sensitive data at rest on servers, applications, and databases containing sensitive data, using techniques such as full-disk, application-level, or database-level encryption.

Safeguard Title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Description: Segment data processing and storage based on the sensitivity of the data, using separate physical or logical infrastructure.

Safeguard Title: Deploy a Data Loss Prevention Solution
Description: Implement an automated tool, such as a host-based data loss prevention (DLP) tool, to identify sensitive data and block or alert on unauthorized attempts to exfiltrate it.

Safeguard Title: Log Sensitive Data Access
Description: Log sensitive data access, including modification and disposal.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
Description: Establish and maintain a documented secure configuration process for enterprise assets and software. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process for Network Infrastructure
Description: Establish and maintain a documented secure configuration process for network devices. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Configure Automatic Session Locking on Enterprise Assets
Description: Configure automatic session locking on enterprise assets after a defined period of inactivity, generally not to exceed 15 minutes for general-purpose operating systems and 2 minutes for mobile end-user devices.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Description: Implement and manage a host-based firewall or port-filtering tool on servers, with a default-deny rule that drops all traffic except services and ports explicitly allowed.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on End-User Devices
Description: Implement and manage a host-based firewall or port-filtering tool on end-user devices, with a default-deny rule that drops traffic except services and ports explicitly allowed.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Securely Manage Enterprise Assets and Software
Description: Securely manage enterprise assets and software using version-controlled infrastructure-as-code, and access via secure network protocols such as SSH and HTTPS rather than insecure protocols.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Manage Default Accounts on Enterprise Assets and Software
Description: Manage default accounts on enterprise assets and software, such as root, administrator, and other pre-configured vendor accounts. Example implementations include disabling default accounts or making them unusable.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
Description: Uninstall or disable unnecessary services on enterprise assets and software, such as an unused file sharing service, web application module, or service function.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Description: Configure trusted DNS servers on enterprise assets, ensuring the use of secure, enterprise-controlled DNS servers.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Enforce Automatic Device Lockout on Portable End-User Devices
Description: Enforce automatic device lockout following a predetermined number of failed authentication attempts on portable end-user devices, where supported.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Enforce Remote Wipe Capability on Portable End-User Devices
Description: Remotely wipe enterprise data from enterprise-owned portable devices when deemed appropriate, such as lost or stolen devices, or when an individual no longer supports the enterprise.

Control Title: Secure Configuration of Enterprise Assets and Software
Safeguard Title: Separate Enterprise Workspaces on Mobile End-User Devices
Description: Ensure separate enterprise workspaces are used on mobile end-user devices, where supported, using containerization or other similar capability.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Accounts
Description: Establish and maintain an inventory of all accounts managed in the enterprise, including both user and administrator accounts. Review and update the inventory at least quarterly, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Use Unique Passwords
Description: Use unique passwords for all enterprise assets. Best practice includes a minimum password length of 14 characters, where technically feasible, and/or multi-factor authentication where supported.

Safeguard Title: Disable Dormant Accounts
Description: Delete or disable any dormant accounts after a defined period of inactivity, generally 45 days.

Safeguard Title: Restrict Administrator Privileges to Dedicated Administrator Accounts
Description: Restrict administrator privileges to dedicated administrator accounts on enterprise assets. Conduct general computing activities, such as internet browsing and email, from a user's primary, non-privileged account.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Accounts
Description: Establish and maintain an inventory of service accounts, including a department owner, review date, and purpose for each account. Review at least quarterly.

Safeguard Title: Centralize Account Management
Description: Centralize account management through a directory or identity service.

Safeguard Title: Establish an Access Granting Process
Description: Establish and follow a documented process, ideally automated, for granting access to enterprise assets upon new hire, rights grant, or role change of a user.

Safeguard Title: Establish an Access Revoking Process
Description: Establish and follow a process, ideally automated, for revoking access to enterprise assets through disabling accounts immediately upon termination, rights revocation, or role change of a user.

Safeguard Title: Require MFA for Externally-Exposed Applications
Description: Require all externally-exposed enterprise or third-party applications to enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA), where supported.

Safeguard Title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Description: Require MFA for remote network access.

Safeguard Title: Require MFA for Administrative Access
Description: Require MFA for all administrative access accounts, where supported, on all enterprise assets, whether managed on-site or through a third-party provider.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Authentication and Authorization Systems
Description: Establish and maintain an inventory of the enterprise's authentication and authorization systems, including those hosted on-site or at a remote service provider. Review at least annually.

Safeguard Title: Centralize Access Control
Description: Centralize access control for all enterprise assets through a directory service or SSO provider, where supported.

Safeguard Title: Define and Maintain Role-Based Access Control
Description: Define and maintain role-based access control, through determining and documenting the access rights necessary for each role within the enterprise to successfully carry out its assigned duties.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
Description: Establish and maintain a documented vulnerability management process for enterprise assets. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
Description: Establish and maintain a risk-based remediation strategy documented in a remediation process, with monthly, or more frequent, reviews.

Safeguard Title: Perform Automated Operating System Patch Management
Description: Perform operating system updates on enterprise assets through automated patch management on a monthly basis, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Perform Automated Application Patch Management
Description: Perform application updates on enterprise assets through automated patch management on a monthly basis, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Internal Enterprise Assets
Description: Perform automated vulnerability scans of internal enterprise assets on a quarterly basis, or more frequently, using a qualified vulnerability scanning tool.

Safeguard Title: Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Externally-Exposed Enterprise Assets
Description: Perform automated vulnerability scans of externally-exposed enterprise assets using a qualified vulnerability scanning tool, on a monthly basis, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Remediate Detected Vulnerabilities
Description: Remediate detected vulnerabilities in software through processes and tooling on a monthly, or more frequent, basis, based on the remediation process.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Audit Log Management Process
Description: Establish and maintain a documented audit log management process that defines the enterprise's logging requirements. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

Safeguard Title: Collect Audit Logs
Description: Collect audit logs, ensuring logging is enabled across enterprise assets and software in accordance with the audit log management process.

Safeguard Title: Ensure Adequate Audit Log Storage
Description: Ensure that logging destinations maintain adequate storage to comply with the enterprise's audit log management process.

Safeguard Title: Standardize Time Synchronization
Description: Standardize time synchronization by configuring at least two synchronized time sources across enterprise assets, where supported.

Safeguard Title: Collect Detailed Audit Logs
Description: Configure detailed audit logging for enterprise assets containing sensitive data, including event source, date, username, timestamp, source addresses, destination addresses, and other useful elements.

Safeguard Title: Collect DNS Query Audit Logs
Description: Collect DNS query audit logs on enterprise assets, where appropriate and supported.

Safeguard Title: Collect URL Request Audit Logs
Description: Collect URL request audit logs on enterprise assets, where appropriate and supported.

Safeguard Title: Collect Command-Line Audit Logs
Description: Collect command-line audit logs, such as PowerShell and Bash history, on enterprise assets.

Safeguard Title: Centralize Audit Logs
Description: Centralize, to the extent possible, audit log collection and retention across enterprise assets.

Safeguard Title: Retain Audit Logs
Description: Retain audit logs across enterprise assets for a minimum of 90 days.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Audit Log Reviews
Description: Conduct reviews of audit logs to detect anomalies or abnormal events that could indicate a potential threat, on a weekly basis, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Collect Service Provider Logs
Description: Collect service provider logs, where supported, such as audit logs on data access, changes to permissions, and administrative actions.

Safeguard Title: Ensure Use of Only Fully Supported Browsers and Email Clients
Description: Ensure only fully supported browsers and email clients are allowed to execute in the enterprise, only using the latest version of browsers and email clients provided through the vendor.

Safeguard Title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Description: Use DNS filtering services on all enterprise assets to block access to known malicious domains.

Safeguard Title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Description: Enforce and update network-based URL filters to limit an enterprise asset from connecting to potentially malicious or unapproved websites.

Safeguard Title: Restrict Unnecessary or Unauthorized Browser and Email Client Extensions
Description: Restrict, either through uninstalling or disabling, any unauthorized or unnecessary browser or email client plugins, extensions, and add-on applications.

Safeguard Title: Implement DMARC
Description: To lower the chance of spoofed or modified emails from valid domains, implement DMARC policy and verification, starting with SPF and DKIM.

Safeguard Title: Block Unnecessary File Types
Description: Block unnecessary file types attempting to enter the enterprise's email gateway.

Safeguard Title: Deploy and Maintain Email Server Anti-Malware Protections
Description: Deploy and maintain email server anti-malware protections, such as attachment scanning and/or sandboxing.

Safeguard Title: Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software
Description: Deploy and maintain anti-malware software on all enterprise assets.

Safeguard Title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Signature Updates
Description: Configure automatic updates for anti-malware signature files on all enterprise assets.

Safeguard Title: Disable Autorun and Autoplay for Removable Media
Description: Disable autorun and autoplay auto-execute functionality for removable media.

Safeguard Title: Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Scanning of Removable Media
Description: Configure anti-malware software to automatically scan removable media.

Safeguard Title: Enable Anti-Exploitation Features
Description: Enable anti-exploitation features on enterprise assets and software, where possible, such as Microsoft Data Execution Prevention (DEP), ASLR, or exploit protection.

Safeguard Title: Centrally Manage Anti-Malware Software
Description: Centrally manage anti-malware software.

Safeguard Title: Use Behavior-Based Anti-Malware Software
Description: Use behavior-based anti-malware software, such as endpoint detection and response (EDR) tooling.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Data Recovery Process
Description: Establish and maintain a documented data recovery process that includes provisions for the scope of data recovery activities. Review and update documentation annually, or when significant enterprise changes occur.

Safeguard Title: Perform Automated Backups
Description: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets. Run backups weekly, or more frequently, based on the sensitivity of the data.

Safeguard Title: Protect Recovery Data
Description: Protect recovery data with equivalent controls to the original data, including encryption and off-site storage.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Isolated Instance of Recovery Data
Description: Establish and maintain an isolated instance of recovery data, such as a physically separate storage location, that is not directly accessible by an unauthorized user.

Safeguard Title: Test Data Recovery
Description: Test backup recovery quarterly, or more frequently, for a sampling of in-scope enterprise assets.

Safeguard Title: Ensure Network Infrastructure is Up-to-Date
Description: Ensure network infrastructure is kept up-to-date, using the latest stable release of software and firmware provided by the vendor.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Description: Design and maintain a secure network architecture that addresses factors such as least privilege access, control of internal and external network flows, and network segmentation. Review and update annually.

Safeguard Title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Description: Securely manage network infrastructure, using version-controlled configuration files, secure network protocols, and dedicated administrative accounts.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain Architecture Diagram(s)
Description: Establish and maintain architecture diagram(s) and/or other documentation depicting the data flow, network topology, and system architecture. Review and update annually, or when significant changes occur.

Safeguard Title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Description: Centralize network AAA for the entire enterprise infrastructure, where supported.

Safeguard Title: Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols
Description: Use secure network management and communication protocols, such as 802.1X, Wireless Protected Access 2 (WPA2) Enterprise or greater, and SSH.

Safeguard Title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise's AAA Infrastructure
Description: Require users to authenticate to enterprise-managed VPN and authentication services prior to accessing enterprise resources on end-user devices.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
Description: Establish and maintain dedicated computing resources, either physically or logically separated, for administrative tasks and tasks requiring elevated access.

Safeguard Title: Centralize Security Event Alerting
Description: Centralize security event alerting across enterprise assets for log correlation and analysis, using a security information and event management (SIEM) tool or similar.

Safeguard Title: Deploy a Host-Based Intrusion Detection Solution
Description: Deploy a host-based intrusion detection solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate and/or supported.

Safeguard Title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Description: Deploy a network intrusion detection solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate.

Safeguard Title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Description: Perform traffic filtering between network segments, where appropriate.

Safeguard Title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Description: Manage access control for assets remote from the enterprise's network, ensuring that remote assets meet minimum security requirements prior to connecting.

Safeguard Title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Description: Collect network traffic flow logs and/or network traffic to review and alert upon from network devices.

Safeguard Title: Deploy a Host-Based Intrusion Prevention Solution
Description: Deploy a host-based intrusion prevention solution on enterprise assets, where appropriate and/or supported.

Safeguard Title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
Description: Deploy a network intrusion prevention solution, where appropriate.

Safeguard Title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
Description: Deploy port-level access control, using 802.1x, or similar network access control tooling.

Safeguard Title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
Description: Perform application layer filtering, such as a proxy or web application firewall, in front of critical servers.

Safeguard Title: Tune Security Event Alerting Thresholds
Description: Tune security event alerting thresholds monthly, or more frequently.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Security Awareness Program
Description: Establish and maintain a security awareness program to influence workforce behavior to be security conscious. Conduct training at hire and, at a minimum, annually.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce Members to Recognize Social Engineering Attacks
Description: Train workforce members to recognize social engineering attacks, such as phishing, pretexting, and tailgating.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce Members on Authentication Best Practices
Description: Train workforce members on authentication best practices, such as MFA, password composition, and credential management.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce on Data Handling Best Practices
Description: Train workforce members on how to identify and properly store, transfer, archive, and destroy sensitive data.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce Members on Causes of Unintentional Data Exposure
Description: Train workforce members to be aware of causes for unintentional data exposure, such as losing a portable device or emailing the wrong recipient.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce Members on Recognizing and Reporting Security Incidents
Description: Train workforce members to be able to identify the most common indicators of an incident and be able to report such an incident.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce on How to Identify and Report if Their Enterprise Assets are Missing Security Updates
Description: Train workforce to understand how to verify and report out-of-date software patches or any failures in automated processes and tools.

Safeguard Title: Train Workforce on the Dangers of Connecting to and Transmitting Enterprise Data Over Insecure Networks
Description: Train workforce members on the dangers of connecting to, and transmitting data over, insecure networks for enterprise activities, and how to mitigate these risks, such as use of a VPN.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Role-Specific Security Awareness and Skills Training
Description: Conduct role-specific security awareness and skills training, such as secure system administration for IT staff and secure coding for developers.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Inventory of Service Providers
Description: Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers, ensuring the inventory lists all known service providers, classification(s), and designated enterprise contact(s). Review at least annually.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Service Provider Management Policy
Description: Establish and maintain a service provider management policy that ensures all third-party service providers are assessed against a set of security requirements. Review and update annually.

Safeguard Title: Classify Service Providers
Description: Classify service providers based on the sensitivity and volume of data accessible to the service provider, and the risk to the enterprise from this data access.

Safeguard Title: Ensure Service Provider Contracts Include Security Requirements
Description: Ensure service provider contracts include security requirements, such as minimum security program requirements, notification of security incidents, and data disposal terms.

Safeguard Title: Assess Service Providers
Description: Assess service providers consistent with the enterprise's service provider management policy, using standardized security questionnaires or independent audits/assessments.

Safeguard Title: Monitor Service Providers
Description: Monitor service providers consistent with the enterprise's service provider management policy, including periodic reassessment of their compliance and any changes to their service delivery.

Safeguard Title: Securely Decommission Service Providers
Description: Securely decommission service providers, considering factors such as user and service account deactivation, termination of data flows, and secure disposal of enterprise data.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Application Development Process
Description: Establish and maintain a secure application development process addressing storage of code, secure design, code review, and application security testing throughout the development lifecycle. Review annually.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Process to Accept and Address Software Vulnerabilities
Description: Establish and maintain a process to accept and address reports of software vulnerabilities, including a means for external entities to report through a vulnerability disclosure program.

Safeguard Title: Perform Root Cause Analysis on Security Vulnerabilities
Description: Perform root cause analysis on security vulnerabilities to determine underlying causes.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Manage an Inventory of Third-Party Software Components
Description: Establish and manage an updated inventory of third-party components used in development, often referred to as a bill of materials (BOM), as well as components slated for future use.

Safeguard Title: Use Up-to-Date and Trusted Third-Party Software Components
Description: Use up-to-date and trusted third-party software components, favoring versions supported by an actively maintained project or vendor.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Severity Rating System and Process for Application Vulnerabilities
Description: Establish and maintain a severity rating system and process for application vulnerabilities that facilitates prioritizing the order in which discovered vulnerabilities are fixed.

Safeguard Title: Use Standard Hardening Configuration Templates for Application Infrastructure
Description: Use standard, industry-recommended hardening configuration templates for application infrastructure components.

Safeguard Title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Description: Maintain separate environments for production and non-production systems.

Safeguard Title: Train Developers in Application Security Concepts and Secure Coding
Description: Ensure that all software development personnel receive training in writing secure code for their specific development environment and responsibilities.

Safeguard Title: Apply Secure Design Principles in Application Architectures
Description: Apply secure design principles in application architectures, such as designing access control to be applied at each layer and enforcing least privilege at every layer.

Safeguard Title: Leverage Vetted Modules or Services for Application Security Components
Description: Leverage vetted modules or services for application security components, such as identity management, encryption, and auditing/logging, rather than building components from scratch.

Safeguard Title: Implement Code-Level Security Checks
Description: Apply static and dynamic analysis tools within the application lifecycle to verify secure coding practices are being followed prior to production release.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Application Penetration Testing
Description: Conduct application penetration testing, engaging authorized testers to attempt to exploit weaknesses in the application prior to release.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Threat Modeling
Description: Conduct threat modeling for applications to identify and understand potential threats and attack vectors, such as structured/misuse-case analysis.

Safeguard Title: Designate Personnel to Manage Incident Handling
Description: Designate one key person, and at least one backup, to manage the incident handling process.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain Contact Information for Reporting Security Incidents
Description: Establish and maintain contact information for parties that need to be informed of security incidents, such as internal staff, third-party vendors, and law enforcement. Review annually.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Enterprise Process for Reporting Incidents
Description: Establish and maintain an enterprise process for workforce members to report security incidents, including reporting timeframe, personnel to report to, and required information.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain an Incident Response Process
Description: Establish and maintain an incident response process that addresses roles and responsibilities, compliance requirements, and communication plans. Review annually, or after major incidents.

Safeguard Title: Assign Key Roles and Responsibilities
Description: Assign key roles and responsibilities for incident response, including staff from legal, IT, information security, facilities, public relations, human resources, incident responders, and analysts.

Safeguard Title: Define Mechanisms for Communicating During Incident Response
Description: Determine which primary and secondary mechanisms will be used to communicate and report during a security incident, ensuring redundancy of communication channels.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Routine Incident Response Exercises
Description: Plan and conduct routine incident response exercises and scenarios to ensure that personnel understand current threats and risks, and their roles during an incident.

Safeguard Title: Conduct Post-Incident Reviews
Description: Conduct post-incident reviews to help prevent incident recurrence through identifying lessons learned and any follow-up actions.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain Security Incident Thresholds
Description: Establish and maintain security incident thresholds, including at a minimum, differentiating between an incident and an event.

Safeguard Title: Establish and Maintain a Penetration Testing Program
Description: Establish and maintain a penetration testing program appropriate to the size, complexity, and maturity of the enterprise.

Safeguard Title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Description: Perform periodic external penetration tests based on program requirements, at least annually, against the enterprise's network and application boundary.

Safeguard Title: Remediate Penetration Test Findings
Description: Remediate penetration test findings based on the enterprise's documented remediation process, ensuring root causes are addressed rather than individual findings alone.

Safeguard Title: Validate Security Measures
Description: Validate security measures after each penetration test, incorporating results into a continuous improvement cycle by remediating findings that are not false positives.

Safeguard Title: Perform Periodic Internal Penetration Tests
Description: Perform periodic internal penetration tests based on program requirements, at least annually, to identify and exploit weaknesses within the enterprise's internal network.
